title: Single Source Entity Layers
description: Implement single-source entity layers: Rust BackboneKind, kit backbones, EventBus path subscribe, remove hydrate; JS Kit.open URI, backbone mutations; React Context rename, OperationStatus, bindFieldToReact without useSyncExternalStore.
summary: Implemented BackboneKind (Dev/Local/Remote) with from_uri; native AttachedBackbone mounts derive kind from URI (local:// for SQLite backbone); renamed Dev/Local attach structs; Command::BackboneAttach drops redundant store_kind; added session.backbone GraphQL nav (attach/detach/status/setActiveCheckpoint/syncNow) and BackboneStatus SDL; removed hydrateKitStoreBundleJson mutation; WASM KitStoreHandle.create now takes backbone/bootstrap URI (dev://empty, dev+json:base64, dev://fetchable URL) with internal bundle vs kit JSON routing; EventBus.subscribe_paths MVP forwards to subscribe. JS: Kit.open maps inline JSON to dev+json URI, worker init uses uri, attachBackbone/detachBackbone mutations. React: fixed Entity generic constraints and removed recursive useType().
